research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Anaqua is researching a system for determining product strategies based on product and IP asset data. The method for determining strategies with regards to product protection and market exclusivity combines information such as clinical trial dates and intellectual property details to optimize protection and exclusivity decisions. This work focuses on integrated analysis of product data, IP asset management, and strategic decision support for market protection, coverage, and lifecycle strategy.

overview_description.description:
Anaqua provides IP management software and services to some of the world’s leading IP owners. These include Anaqua Enterprise for large IP owners, Anaqua Express for smaller IP teams, ANAQUA Element for cloud-based IP management, ANAQUA Essential for law firms and Anaqua Services for IP maintenance payments. Anaqua products are designed for all types of intellectual property, including inventions, patents, trademarks and more.

Anaqua manages the full IP lifecycle and is a completely web-based system with automated workflow, integrated document and email management and advanced query and reporting. It is designed to enhance business productivity and IP visibility for all participants in the IP management process.
